- D. Family.For definition, see Subject 4 under Section 17.  
If both husband and wife contribute to the CGHS, eligible parents of both may avail the benefits.  
Irrespective of age, the permanently disabled unmarried sons (both physical and mental/schizophrenia illness) who are financially dependent on CGHS beneficiary and residing with CGHS beneficiary and suffering or more of disabilities are eligible to avail CGHS facilities.
